title: Venezuelan Pasta Fritters
description: Crispy pasta fritters with a flavorful Venezuelan twist, made with wild springy farfalle pasta and a hint of Venezuelan spices.

ingredients.name: Wild Springy Farfalle Pasta
ingredients.notes: any other short pasta shape will do

instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (175°C).
Combine the farfalle pasta, Venezuelan pasta, parmesan cheese, onion, cilantro, and spice blend in a large bowl.
Beat the egg in a separate bowl and add to the pasta mixture. Mix well.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small balls, about 1 inch in diameter.
Once the oil is hot, carefully place the pasta balls into the oil.
Fry for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and crispy.
Remove the fritters from the oil with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Season with salt to taste. Serve hot and enjoy!
